text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the shopping district,
I ran into Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—What're you staring at me like you've seen a ghost for?
Is it really that weird to see me eating street food?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I ran out of ramune candies for my glucose boost.
Lately, they've been disappearing weirdly fast...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, your brain craving more sugar than it needs is a bad sign.
I've gotta be careful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps Air Shakur is still feeling the fatigue from the race. It looks like we'll need to reconsider our upcoming racing schedule."
